candidates.description: This vector activates for German modal and auxiliary verbs expressing necessity, possibility, or future tense.
This vector represents common German verbs in various forms.
These tokens represent German masculine and neuter genitive and dative singular determiners and pronouns.
This vector represents common German third-person singular and plural present-tense verb stems.
These tokens function as German subordinating conjunctions and relative pronouns that introduce dependent clauses.
These tokens represent capitalized and lowercase consonant blends starting with labial or alveolar stops followed by liquid consonants like 'r'.
This vector represents the German letter 'ä' and its associated accented variants, umlauts, and common sub-word tokens containing it.
This feature activates on German prefix tokens and word fragments starting with "ver-".
This feature vector represents the concept of Christianity and related religious terms, figures, and denominations.
This vector is related to common German adjectival and nominal suffixes and derivational endings.
